question: Of the two bulbs, one glows brighter than the other. Which bulb has a higher resistance (Connecting the two bulbs one by one with the same voltage source, not together)?
solution: __**CONCEPT**__: • Power: The rate of work done by an electric current is called power. It is denoted by P. The SI unit of power is the watt (W). Power dissipation is given by: Power (P) = V I = V2/R = I2 R
